description: Consider a 3D sandpile model where each site with 3 or more grains, say at location (x, y, z), topples and transfers one grain of sand to the sites at locations (x+1, y, z), (x, y+1, z) and (x, y, z+1); a(n) gives the number of nonempty sites after stabilization of a configuration starting with n grains at the origin.
